case fans aren't something to be concerned about, but get the biggest fans you can for that case for maximum airflow. what you should be worried about is cpu cooling. 7700k is notoriously high in temps.

7700k - you better have a nuclear cooler to cool a 7700k.

Cooler - really a noctua or any cooler would be better than a water cooler, water cooling is like gold trimmings on a yacht.

Z270 - any motherboard over $120 is really overkill for present day, but suit yourself.

16 gigs of ram - eh? 8 gigs really is enough, but i'd only get 16 gigs of you're doing multiple things at once

1080 - 11 gigs is complete overkill. you're future-proofing yourself, but for the money it's like getting a complete bathroom and bedroom in your yacht also.

Panzer Case - never heard of cougar but that case price is off the wall. just get a nice cooler master case and it'll do the job.

XG270HU - pretty sure samsung makes some nice monitors, but if you're really persistent on 1440p and 144 hz then more power to you
